title: Apollo’s Brightspeed in Creditor Talks for Billions in New Money
summary: Brightspeed and its creditors are locked in talks for a multibillion-dollar funding lifeline as the broadband provider grapples with a heavy debt burden amid its capital intensive fiber internet rollout.

title: Why Blizzard Made ‘World of Warcraft: Forever’
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever takes players to an alternate reality version of the popular online game

title: TSMC Mulls Making Advanced AI Memory Chips, Information Says
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is considering broadening its business to include advanced memory chip manufacturing, The Information reported, a move that would give the world’s largest chipmaker an even bigger share of the AI hardware supply chain.

title: Brookfield’s Teskey Calls ‘Social License’ Crucial for AI Growth
summary: Brookfield Asset Management Chief Executive Officer Connor Teskey said it’s crucial to obtain buy-in from local communities before constructing artificial intelligence infrastructure.

title: Tech Stocks Rebound as Investors Weigh Valuations After Rout
summary: US stocks advanced Friday as dip buyers stepped in to support the battered artificial intelligence trade, though the severity of this week’s rout has left investors questioning whether the worst is over.

title: Power On: Ternus vs. Cook — Who Did Earnings Calls Better?
summary:
Some Apple investors and fans are saying that CEO John Ternus' seemingly scripted earnings call failed to inspire.

On this episode of the Power On podcast, Mark Gurman and Vlad Savov compare Ternus' performance with Tim Cook's. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: JFrog Soars After Raising View for Strongest Growth in Years
summary: Digital security provider JFrog Ltd. soared after predicting its fastest revenue growth in four years as artificial intelligence gives hackers more sophisticated ways to test companies’ security, driving demand for the digital defenses it offers.

title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Expectations Hit After AI Rout
summary: Prospective investors in Anthropic's IPO are facing a weekend of uncertainty after a punishing post-election selloff in AI stocks prompted a rethink of the company’s expected valuation. Tom Mackenzie explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rieder Surprised by Recent Market Action, Advises Balanced Strategy
summary: Rick Rieder, BlackRock's global fixed income CIO, says having a balanced and diverse portfolio is the best hedge in the current market environment. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: TikTok Owner ByteDance Weighs Data Center Expansion in Brazil
summary: TikTok owner ByteDance is considering expanding a data center project in northeastern Brazil, a move that would strengthen its standing as Latin America’s leading builder of computing facilities.

title: AST SpaceMobile to Build Own Rocket to Compete With SpaceX
summary: AST SpaceMobile Inc., a satellite company that competes against SpaceX, announced that it is building its own rocket that will be powered by engines from Firefly Aerospace Inc.

title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Under Pressure After Tech Rout
summary: The selloff in tech stocks could hurt Anthropic. Potential buyers are discussing a valuation range of $1.2 trillion to $1.3 trillion for the company, which could go public before Thanksgiving. Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ECB Considers Review of Bank Data Center Lending on AI Risk
summary: The euro area’s top banking supervisor is considering a review of lending related to data centers, seeking to gauge potential risks from swings in AI sentiment and valuations.

title: Nvidia’s AI Chip Exports Emerge as Target in Democratic Congress
summary: Nvidia Corp. is in for tougher scrutiny from a new Democratic majority in Congress that’s set to demand answers from Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang about whether the company is doing enough to keep its coveted artificial intelligence chips out of the hands of China and other US adversaries.

title: Cloudflare Rises After AI Demand Lifts Annual Profit View
summary: Cloudflare Inc. lifted its profit forecast for a third time this year as rapid adoption of artificial intelligence continues to boost demand for networking services.

title: Protesters Break Into Microsoft Data Center in Amsterdam
summary: More than 100 protesters broke into a data center construction site for Microsoft Corp. in Amsterdam on Friday, part of wider coordinated action planned across Europe against such facilities through the weekend.

title: Markets Focused More on AI Than Jobs Report, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, systematic multi-strategy fund portfolio manager at BlackRock, says markets are reacting less to the employment report than to recent overseas developments, futures trading and concerns about the AI-driven growth outlook. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Is AI Degrading Our Music Taste?
summary:
"AI systems were built on data that was stolen."

Max Richter tells Mishal Husain that human composers should get paid when AI uses their work to make music. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: EU Escalates TikTok Probe Over Algorithmic ‘Rabbit Holes’
summary: TikTok moved one step closer to a new European Union fine after regulators found its video-recommendation algorithm pushes users down “rabbit holes” of potentially harmful content, escalating an almost three-year probe into the video-sharing app.

title: Home-Renovation Expense Keeps Rising as Companies Pass on Costs
summary: Households squeezed by high grocery and gas prices are facing another hit: rising costs for home repairs and upgrades.
